'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Alex Levine LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Alex Levine]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Username:''' Conner the Cat
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
